facts.activity_file: making up, decanting and dosing reagents

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: restraint and placarding of transported loads

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at TK-8311

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_RESTRAINT_AND_PLACARDING: the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the restraint and placarding of transported loads on TK-8311 and LT-8311 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in handling and dosing reagents, specifically making up, decanting and dosing reagents. TK-8311 (reagent storage tanks) is in service for bulk reagent storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the restraint and placarding of transported loads was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 24 July 2014 a hazard report was recorded on TK-8311 and LT-8311 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during transfer operations; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
